text:
tara: FYI — Lumen Financial just sent back the security questionnaire and a POC checklist. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and domain proofing. Asking for what we can provide by EOD.

eli: Got it. Quick summary we should send: SAML metadata (SP), ACS URLs, supported bindings, required assertion attributes, cert fingerprint & rotation policy, and example IdP config.

eli: Example of the minimal SAML attributes we ask for:

```
nameid: emailAddress
attributes:
  - email: urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3
  - given_name: givenName
  - family_name: sn
  - groups: groups
  - role: custom:role
```

dan: Security sidenote: we require SAML assertions signed with RSA-SHA256, support SP-initiated + IdP-initiated. We'll provide a cert rotation schedule (30-day notice). For their InfoSec questionnaire: include SOC2 attestation reference, KMS/HSM support for Private deployments, and audit log retention policy.

eli: SCIM details to share: we support SCIM 2.0, users and groups endpoints, and delta provisioning. Recommend they provision a scoped service account token for the POC (no admin creds). Rate limit guidance: default is 5 RPS per tenant with short bursts; large customers can request increased limits for Dedicated.

eli: Example SCIM provisioning curl for POC:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/scim/v2/Users \
  -d '{"userName":"jdoe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"John","familyName":"Doe"},"emails":[{"value":"jdoe@example.com","primary":true}]}'
```

tara: For RBAC they want role → group mapping and fine-grained permissions. What format should they give roles in?

eli: Ask for a CSV or JSON with: role_name, description, example_groups, allowed_routes (API endpoints/features). We'll provide a sample mapping.

eli: Sample mapping snippet:

```json
[
  {"role_name":"admin","description":"full access","example_groups":["infra-admins"],"allowed_routes":["/v1/generate","/v1/models/*"]},
  {"role_name":"read_only","description":"can view usage","example_groups":["auditors"],"allowed_routes":["/v1/usage","/v1/metrics"]}
]
```

dan: Domain proofing: they need to add a DNS TXT record for verification. We require proof per-tenant for multi-tenant setups; for SSO they should also provide the IdP domain and any inbound assertion constraints.

maria: Commercials: for a short POC on Hosted API we can use free credits and a temporary support tier. If they want Dedicated/reserved capacity (predictable latency at scale) that's a separate quote — typical SOW includes a monthly reserved capacity fee + onboarding. I'll draft two options: 30d POC (hosted + credits) and a 3mo Dedicated eval (quote).

tara: Are there any enterprise blockers we should flag now to the AE?

dan: Yes — data residency (they asked for EU-only), encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (Private only or Dedicated with KMS integration), and proof of penetration testing. Call out that Private/on-prem supports air-gapped; Hosted supports region restrictions but not customer-managed HSM unless Private.

eli: Operationally for the POC we'll need: (1) test IdP metadata, (2) SCIM token and example user list, (3) RBAC mapping file, (4) test domain for TXT proofing. If they want domain-level routing we need org-level settings — will require an SRE ticket to enable.

tara: Good checklist. I'm going to reply to Lumen with the ask list and timeline. Maria/Dan/Eli — can you each drop the docs/snippets you own into the POC folder by EOD? I'll copy into the customer email.

maria: I'll put the pricing options and sample SOW into the drive, tagging @tara.

dan: Uploading security one-pager + cert rotation policy now. Add me to any legal questions.

eli: I'll create a step-by-step quickstart that includes SAML metadata, SCIM examples, and RBAC template. Will also include the small curl snippets for POC.

infra-bot: deploy finished: staging/redwood-poc-templates @3990001220

tara: Thanks team — I'll send the response and loop in the customer's IdP admin. If any of you want to hop on a quick call with Lumen's engineer tomorrow at 10am PT to walk the SAML/SCIM flow, say +1 here.

eli: +1

maria: +1

dan: +1

tara: great, I'll schedule and send invites.
